newsitem.title: FRANCE: Agent 007 searching France for Russians, Afghans.
newsitem.headline: Agent 007 searching France for Russians, Afghans.

text.p: James Bond, the British super-sleuth, is hunting for Russians and Afghans in southern France.
Secret agent 007's plans have been divulged in classified advertisements placed in several local newspapers seeking male extras who look either Russian or Afghan for the next Bond film.

The title of the film, the 18th starring Bond, has not yet been announced. Metro Goldwyn Mayer Inc, which made the highly successful "Golden Eye" in 1995, has been keeping tight wraps on details of the new Bond epic.
But Jean-Paul Vassort, director of the Luchon tourist office, said the filmmakers planned to use the area to shoot the destruction of an Afghan military base by the Russians.
Bond will be played by Pierce Brosnan, who starred in "Golden Eye". Previous Bonds were Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore and Timothy Dalton.
